With this new capital, Team8 now manages nearly $2 billion in assets under management across eight funds since launching in 2014. At Team8, we back Seed and Series A founders building across cybersecurity, software infrastructure, fintech, and digital health. These are the categories where AI is creating real urgency, real opportunity, and a clear need for durable companies built for enterprise adoption from day one. Our model is designed to support that journey in a deeper way. We work side by side with founders from the earliest stages, combining capital with a multidisciplinary team of builders and our Villages of enterprise C-level leaders. Together, that model helps companies sharpen the problem, validate the solution, and scale with greater speed and conviction. Over the years, we’ve had the privilege of working closely with our ProFounders through every stage of growth, and we continue to back them as they build and grow. This new capital strengthens our ability to do what matters most to us: support exceptional founders early, help them build with purpose, and continue showing up as long-term partners as they scale. We’re grateful to our LPs, founders, team, and broader community for being part of this journey. And we’re just getting started. With deep domain expertise, a global village, and an operator-first mindset, we help you scale faster, de-risk early, and succeed by design. Backing bold ideas with real conviction. Team8 Capital is tightly integrated with our creation model, giving us a unique edge in identifying, validating, and scaling the right opportunities. We combine early-stage investment with deep operational support, helping founders navigate complexity with clarity. Whether we build together or back you at Seed or Series A, we bring more than capital: we bring a method. The building process Investment review We don’t chase trends. We back thesis-aligned opportunities where we can add real value. Every deal starts with deep market understanding and founder alignment. Due diligence With our cross-functional team of builders, technologists, and researchers, we pressure-test the product, team, and market to make sure the foundation is solid. Video not supported. Liran Grinberg Co-Founder & Managing Partner Building success by design “We start with understanding the problem space from every angle, the attacker, the practitioner, the builder. We combine that expertise with a validation-obsessed mindset, engaging hundreds of potential customers to ensure every company we build is grounded in real data and real needs.” Video not supported. Ori Barzilay Partner A few stars have to align "At Team8, before we back a company, we look for alignment across three things: founder–market fit, the size of the opportunity, and execution capability. We’re looking for teams with the right mission, tackling uncapped markets, and able to deliver." Video not supported. Sarit Firon Managing Partner More than funding "As someone who's worked in many venture funds as an operator, this level of support that team8 provides is very rare... What excites me about early stage investing is it's not about funding a business, it's about creating one... It's about the people, the problem they are solving, and what they are really made of for the long journey." Video not supported. Hadar Siterman Norris Partner Fintech’s AI moment "AI is something that we’ve been introduced to over the last couple of years, but we’re really seeing a very strong wave of innovation coming in fintech, cyber, and data infrastructure. In fintech specifically, we’re seeing a lot of founders build in areas where workflows and context are really important, including compliance, legal services, and accounting. CFOs today know that technology is going to make their lives better—it’s not a question of whether they’ll spend on technology, it’s a question of what they’ll bring in and when."
